integrity: The source equations, global-periodic-solution theorem, and Case 2 parameters were checked in the publisher text. The mean identities were reconstructed directly from period averages and strict positivity, and the exact Case 2 algebra is replayed by the bundled standard-library checker. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is conditional on a classical strictly positive periodic solution and does not assert existence, uniqueness, or stability.
The proof is specific to the displayed Wu–Zheng delayed model and uses exact period-shift invariance.
The general lower prey-mean bound can be noninformative for some parameter values; the source Case 2 specialization is informative.
The 2019 motivating predecessor was not available as complete lawful full text; comparison used its bibliographic record and the delayed source presentation of the predecessor equation.
Unindexed literature could contain an equivalent short averaging observation under different terminology.
title: Delay-independent finite-amplitude mean corridor for periodic predator–prey branches
